item.title: MiniWorld + DROID: Structured Event Prediction
item.description:
Research question

Can a video world model preserve enough action and motion evidence for a downstream model to forecast structured robot states? This project treats MiniWorld generation as an evidence source and evaluates it with a fixed video representation and causal event head.

Method

  1. MiniWorld-1B produces an action-conditioned 253-frame rollout from a DROID observation and action sequence.
  2. DINOv2 converts sampled frames into frozen visual features.
  3. A causal GRU predicts gripper level, end-effector motion, vertical direction, and gripper change at a 1.2 s horizon.
  4. Real robot telemetry provides weak supervision; object contact, grasp success, and task completion are not claimed.

Results

Track Metric Result
World model rollout PSNR / SSIM 23.38 dB / 0.876
Future state prediction macro-F1 0.451
Single-frame baseline macro-F1 0.404
Boundary matching F1 / MAE 0.311 / 0.402 s

Inspectable artifact

Open the to compare the reference and generated videos against synchronized telemetry values and event boundaries. The static assets live under /media/, /data.json, and /assets/ so the page can be deployed as a standalone Hugo artifact.
